$comment: Template for `.cmux/cmux.json` at an adopted repo's root — render the package-manager token in `command` at adoption and COMMIT the file. cmux resolves it per active-pane cwd (ancestor lookup), so the action exists in every worktree of the repo automatically, main checkout included, and appears in the Command Palette (⌘⇧P). `target: newTabInCurrentPane` runs the command as shell input in a new tab of the current pane — inside the task's own workspace, which is exactly what `--here` is built for: it detaches itself before the workspace it is about to close can kill it. cmux asks a one-time trust question on the action's first run; that is its model for project-local actions. Action shape [read-in-source, cmux dogfood/directory-actions, 2026-08-14].
